card.title: PlayStation 5 SSD Controller Current Isolation Procedure

claims.statement: A faulty SSD controller can be diagnosed by lifting fuse F7520 and measuring current draw in series using a multimeter.
claims.evidence: Current consumption testing method for the SSD power circuit.
claims.quote: Remove fuse F7520 that feeds the voltage on the back to the voltage regulator that generates power for the SSD circuit. Set a multimeter in current mode in series with the pads of the fuse and measure the current draw. G

procedure: Locate and remove fuse F7520 feeding the SSD voltage regulator.
Connect a multimeter set to current measurement mode in series across the fuse pads.
Power on the board and verify if current draw matches the normal 310mA working expectation.

measurements.context: normal working SSD circuit current draw measured across F7520 pads

card.caveats: Ensure meter leads are securely connected in series to prevent voltage drop or blown meter fuse.
